def factor_price_impact_downside_vol_adjusted_mut(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy['close']
    volume = df_copy['volume']
    ret = close.pct_change()
    abs_ret = ret.abs()
    impact = abs_ret / volume.replace(0, np.nan)
    avg_impact = impact.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol = ret.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).std()
    factor = avg_impact / vol.replace(0, np.nan)
    # Downside/upside return magnitude ratio over longer window for stability
    pos_sum = ret.where(ret > 0, 0).rolling(60, min_periods=30).sum()
    neg_sum = ret.where(ret < 0, 0).rolling(60, min_periods=30).sum()
    ratio = (-neg_sum) / pos_sum.replace(0, np.nan)
    ratio = ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(1.0)
    # Use ratio as a dampener when upside dominant (ratio<1) to reduce false signals
    factor = factor * np.where(ratio >= 1.0, 1.0, ratio)
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0)
    df_copy['factor_price_impact_downside_vol_adjusted_mut'] = factor
    return df_copy['factor_price_impact_downside_vol_adjusted_mut']

The parent combined price impact per unit volatility with a downside/upside return magnitude ratio, but failed the payoff gate on top quantile excess return.
